description: Transaction receipt on HyperEVM (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in HYPE, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use hyperevm_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xdcf371c993312e793176e32cdfa78af2101b4aa54df88f8f0051c3fe463e374a. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: hyperevm_receipt
title: HyperEVM transaction receipt
